introduce: Sit on a chair with your hands gripping the back of the chair.\n\nInhale deeply and open up your chest and shoulders. Hold for a few seconds.
name: SHOULDER STRETCH WITH CHAIR

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Don't shrug your shoulders.
Breathe deeply and steadily.

introduce: Bend your elbows at 90 degrees with your upper arms out to your sides, keeping them parallel to the floor and your palms facing forward.\n\nExhale, press your forearms against each other. Inhale, return to the starting position. Repeat.
name: SEATED BENT ARM CHEST FLY

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale as you press your forearms together, and inhale as you return.
Keep your back straight.
Feel the squeeze on your chest.
Press your forearms against each other as hard as you can.
Keep your arms at a 90 degree angle.
This exercise activates your upper back muscles and improves your posture.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair. 

Tuck your chin, and round your back as you exhale. Then take a breath in, and look up, trying to drive your chest out. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR CAT COW

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.
You should not feel tenseness in your shoulders or back.
This exercise works on your upper back and helps stretch your spine.

introduce:
Place your hands behind your ears, with your elbows pointing outward.

Exhale, lean from your waist and contract your obliques, bending to one side as far as possible.

Inhale, return to the starting position. Switch sides and repeat.
name: CHAIR SIDE BEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Exhale as you bend to the side, and inhale as you return.
You can feel your obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce:
Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upwards.

Inhale, lengthen your spine and stretch your arms toward the ceiling.

Gently move your shoulders down and back to enhance the stretch in your upper back.

Keep your neck neutral. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR PALM TREE POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Keep your back straight.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose can wake up the muscles of your shoulders and back.
This pose helps increase the flexibility of your back, shoulders and arms.

introduce: Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upwards. Stretch your arms overhead.\n\nInhale, push your belly and chest forward and your chin up. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR BACKBEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This exercise stretches your upper body.

introduce: Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back.\n\nFold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.

introduce:
Stand in front of a chair with your feet hip-width apart. Hold the chair back with your hands.

Slowly step back and lower your chest towards the floor. Pull your hips away from the chair.

Don't bend your knees and press your heels on the floor. Transfer your weight into your feet. Maintain deep and steady breathing. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR DOWNWARD FACING DOG

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Take deep and steady breaths.
This pose stretches your spine, shoulders and legs.
